This '''[[Band/Legends|band]]''', which was comprised of members of the [[Turan]] [[Species/Legends|species]], performed in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. In that show, they incorporated [[soft percussion drum]]s, [[electric harp]]s, and [[base nose flute]]s. [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] enjoyed their show.<ref name="Payback" />
